data:text/html,<body style=margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:%23000><canvas id=c></canvas><span id=o style=position:fixed;top:10px;left:12px;color:%23fff;font:12px monospace;opacity:.7>steer with mouse - hold = boost - <b id=m>0</b> ly</span><script>for(X=c.getContext("2d"),W=c.width=innerWidth,H=c.height=innerHeight,N=30,K=10,G=[],i=0;i<30;i++)G.push([i/30,6.28*Math.random()]);function e(e,i,n,o){a=e+6.283*i/10+.02*t,s=1/(n+.15),o[0]=W/2+(220*Math.cos(a)-300*px*n)*s,o[1]=H/2+(220*Math.sin(a)-300*py*n)*s}px=0,py=0,D=0,v=0,M=0,t=0,A=0,o=0,onresize=()=>{W=c.width=innerWidth,H=c.height=innerHeight},onpointermove=t=>{px=t.clientX/W-.5,py=t.clientY/H-.5},onpointerdown=()=>{D=1,A||(A=new AudioContext,o=A.createOscillator(),g=A.createGain(),o.type="sawtooth",o.frequency.value=60,g.gain.value=.04,o.connect(g).connect(A.destination),o.start())},onpointerup=()=>D=0,u=[0,0],q=[0,0],function n(){for(t++,v+=.05*((D?.05:.012)-v),M+=10*v,m.textContent=0|M,o&&o.frequency.setTargetAtTime(50+4e3*v,A.currentTime,.05),X.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,10,.35)",X.fillRect(0,0,W,H),i=0;i<30;i++)for(r=G[i],r[0]-=v,r[0]<=0&&(r[0]+=1,r[1]=6.28*Math.random()),c="hsl("+(3*t+9*i)%25360+",100%25,60%25)",X.strokeStyle=c,k=0;k<10;k++)e(r[1],k,r[0],u),j=(i+1)%2530,e(G[j][1],k,G[j][0],q),X.beginPath(),X.moveTo(u[0],u[1]),X.lineTo(q[0],q[1]),X.stroke();X.fillStyle="%23fff",X.fillRect(W/2-2,H/2-2,4,4),requestAnimationFrame(n)}();</script>
